maker: bell sec.: Carl Benjamin Flemming, Breslau; slide sec. probably Saxon
signature: “Gemacht C.B. Flemming in Breslau 1797” between double lines; maker's mark: Prussian coat of arms.
pitch: F at a = 443; with longer slide section, perhaps E-flat in Chor- or Kammerton.****
mouthpiece: Alto horn, tenorhorn, or perhaps trombone mp, ca. 1830. Saxon style. Diam. of bowl 19.4, throat ca. 4.8, outlet 8.6, depth of bowl 20.3, total length 81.3, rim 3.4.
dimensions: bo 11, be 113, le 1800, int. diam. of mp receiver 11.6, min. diam. of mouthpipe 10.8.
remarks: 7 pos.; Saxon-style rim-wire; some aspects of slide sec. suggest Vogtland manuf.; 1 flat bell-stay, tubular slide-stays; ring in bell-bow; slide-bow reinforced.
